scientific_integrity: A new uniform finite-graph family theorem is supported by explicit critical-face formulas and a published sequential-matching acyclicity proposition. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the first higher-independence complex is classified.
No equivariant topology or arbitrary-degree-two deletion factor is claimed.
The four-rung case reduces to a previously known cycle case; the infinite family contains genuinely new larger deleted-cycle graphs.
Publication priority beyond inspected and indexed sources is not guaranteed.
title: A third-dimensional sphere-wedge theorem for Hamiltonian-cycle-deleted complete bipartite graphs
